title: Cape Reckoning Rising
author: Lior Vane
blurb: Cyrus Nystrom, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
